title: The AI buildout
storyline: The chips, the neoclouds and the hyperscalers that buy from them, racing power, rates and export rules to build AI capacity.

cast.source: docs/research/cycle-phase-crwv-nvda-2026-10.md (peer basket NVDA, CRWV, NBIS, MU, AVGO, AMD); TSM: docs/research/events/nvda-2026-11-18-print.md and docs/research/ai-hardware-constraints-aug-2026.md; MRVL: docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md (swept with AVGO and the hyperscalers as an AI-capex name)
docs/research/events/crwv-2026-11-10-print.md and docs/research/events/nvda-2026-11-18-print.md (their capex prints read through to the chips)
SMH and QQQ: docs/research/events/midterm-elections-2026-11-03.md (QQQ is FT-midterm-elections-2026-11-03-3's benchmark); XLK: the Technology fund in src/domain/sector-coverage.ts

forces.name: Capex guidance in the prints
forces.why: The buyers' capex guidance is the demand the chips and neoclouds sell into; peer AI-hardware prints read through to it (each event's own notes say so).

forces.name: Power and the grid
forces.why: Data centers wait on power: PJM capacity prices it, and ERCOT, NERC and the Texas PUC set the rules for connecting large loads (docs/research/ai-energy-constraint.md).

forces.name: Ratepayer and data-center politics
forces.why: Who pays for the grid data centers need is on ballots and in bills; the midterm ledger's leg 6 tracks it (docs/research/events/midterm-elections-2026-11-03.md).

forces.name: Rates
forces.why: Yields move long-duration AI names (the `rates` kind's own definition in src/domain/market-events-types.ts); the Fed's decisions and Treasury supply set them.

forces.name: Export controls and US–China trade
forces.why: Chip export rules and the US–China trade truce decide who may buy the cast's chips (the Trump–Xi summit's agenda names export controls).

forces.name: The benchmarks' own rebalances
forces.why: XLK and QQQ are the cast's benchmarks and their index owners cap and reweight them on fixed dates; the chips and hyperscalers are among the heaviest names in both, so a rebalance trades the same shares the story is about.

forces.name: AI replacing workers
forces.why: Eric's view that employers cut salary budgets to pay for AI, with layoffs, unemployment and relief to follow (docs/research/convictions/ai-labor-2026-11.md). Challenger's monthly report counts the cuts that cite AI (claim 1); the 120th Congress's first day seats the majority any relief bill needs (claim 6).
